extracted.name: Fried Pumpkin
extracted.description: Chunks of fresh, peeled pumpkin are lightly breaded and then fried in butter until golden brown.
instruction_lines: Cut pumpkin in half, remove seeds, pith and outer skin. Cut into 2x3 inch pieces.
Place 1/2 of pumpkin (2 to 3 pounds) in large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add flour and stir to evenly coat.
Melt butter in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Add pumpkin and cook, turning often until golden brown and tender.
